config.blackcard.enableCustomDisplayName: Enable custom display name for BlackCard
config.blackcard.general.enableCustomDis:
Enable custom display name for BlackCard.
When enabled: shows as '[Item] BlackCard' (e.g., 'Diamond BlackCard').
When disabled: shows simply as 'BlackCard'.
pack.blackcard.description: Black Card Mod - Craft any item!
jei.blackcard.information.description:
Place this Black Card alone in a crafting grid to craft the item specified in its NBT data.
When multiple items are bound, use §bShift + Scroll§r to cycle through them.

NBT Keys:
- bcitem: Item ID string or list (e.g. "minecraft:diamond" or ["minecraft:diamond","minecraft:iron_ingot"])
- targetCount: Output count (integer, default 1)
- bcblacklist: Blacklisted item IDs (string or list)

Legacy key 'targetItem' is also supported.
jei.blackcard.tag_black_card.information:
A tag-based Black Card that can craft any item from a specified tag.
Use §bShift + Scroll§r to cycle through items in the tag.

NBT Keys:
- bctag: Tag ID string or list (e.g. "minecraft:logs" or ["minecraft:logs","forge:ingots/iron"])
- targetCount: Output count
- currentItemIndex: Current cycle index
- bcblacklist: Blacklisted item IDs

Legacy key 'targetTag' is also supported.
jei.blackcard.mod_black_card.information:
A mod-based Black Card that can craft any item from a specified mod.
Use §bShift + Scroll§r to cycle through items in the mod.

NBT Keys:
- bcmodid: Mod ID string or list (e.g. "mekanism" or ["mekanism","thermal"])
- targetCount: Output count
- currentItemIndex: Current cycle index
- bcblacklist: Blacklisted item IDs

Legacy key 'targetMod' is also supported.
